title: Assistant cards
subtitle: Rich UI in the main conversation: the assistant shows options, comparisons, progress, forms and charts as cards; the conclusion stays in the text.
persona_view_hint: Written to assistant.persona_view in hub.json. When on, the assistant draws persona-view and can use the live card tools; this needs client support, and a client without it shows only each card's text.
compat_hint: The assistant keeps drawing the older persona-card (numbers, bars, lines), which every client shows; cards already drawn are not affected.
html_views_hint: Controlled separately by assistant.html_views (on by default). They run only when the switch above is on and that client has passed its security review; otherwise the text shows.
switch_footer: On the hub this takes effect at once, no restart: the card tools and actions, inline card registration and channel relays follow the new value. The assistant's instructions (CLAUDE.md) are rewritten the next time its directory is prepared (a new conversation, or a spare process warmed when the app opens the chat); an assistant process already running keeps the instructions it loaded at start until it starts again.
saved_off: Assistant cards turned off; the assistant is back to persona-card
enable_body: The assistant will draw persona-view cards and live cards in the main conversation (new instructions reach a new conversation or a restarted assistant process). First complete acceptance in a temporary test conversation and make sure your installed clients support them (see Client support below).
enable_body_compat: A client without support shows only each card's text. You can turn this off here at any time; it then goes back to persona-card, which every client shows.
support_footer: What counts is the version installed on each client. Where a client lacks support it shows the card's text (fallback); nothing in the conversation is lost.
support_web_hint: Choosing, forms and live cards are wired up; the hub must offer assistant_views. HTML still shows only its text fallback.
support_apple_hint: Cards and actions are in a build still in development; install a version that supports this protocol. Running HTML automatically is still under security review (#2024, #2025).
support_android_hint: Choosing, forms and live cards use the shared components; the hub must offer assistant_views. HTML still shows only its text fallback.
preview_footer: Synthetic data from schema/extension/examples/assistant/, drawn with the same components as the web client. The preview is not connected to any conversation: presses and forms only change this page, nothing is sent.
example_missing: This example could not be found.
html_not_run: HTML cards do not run in the preview; only their text shows here.
html_hint: In a real conversation a client runs HTML only after passing its security review; otherwise it shows this text too.
press_hint: Press an option or a button on the card to see what it would do in a real conversation.
would_send: A real conversation would send back “{text}”
fallback_title: Text (watch, notifications and clients without support)
